messages:
Lina Park: Quick Q - partner and I finalized guardianship paperwork for my nephew. Can I add him as a dependent to benefits? He's 12.
Omar Aziz: guardianship is a QLE. We'll need court guardianship docs, child's birth certificate, and proof of residency with you. If the child lives primarily with you, eligible.
Clara Brooks: note on age rules: under 26 for medical/dental. For vision check plan docs. If guardianship was finalized midyear, add within 30 days of court date to make effective date the guardianship date.
Lina Park: caseworker said a few docs are sealed. will that be an issue?
Omar Aziz: sealed docs ok; submit what you can and a redacted cover letter explaining sealed items. We'll work with legal to accept court summaries if necessary.
HR Bot: created ticket HR-4477 for Lina Park - dependent add pending docs.
Lina Park: thanks, uploading what I can now.
Clara Brooks: please include childcare school enrollment or pediatrician records showing residence to support full-time custody.
